examples.label: Example 1
examples.code:
<tp-javascript query="square(7)">
  <script type="tp/javascript">
    function square(x) {
      return x * x;
    }
  </script>
</tp-javascript>

attributes.name: filename
attributes.description: Source filename displayed in the toolbar and editor.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: Presentation mode: default and lite show the normal interface; simple opens the editor and hides the header, welcome information and query action buttons.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: External JavaScript source; takes precedence over value and an inline script.

attributes.name: tracer
attributes.description: Enables tracing the current source and query in a drawer initially 75% wide.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Initial program, evaluated when the session starts or resets.

methods.name: applySource(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Starts a fresh session with the edited source.

methods.name: clear(): void
methods.description: Clears output while preserving variables and history.

methods.name: getSource(): Promise<string>
methods.description: Returns the current program, including unsaved editor changes.

methods.name: openTrace(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Opens the trace drawer when tracer is enabled.

methods.name: reset(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Restores the original source and command in a fresh session.

methods.name: run(code?: string): Promise<void>
methods.description: Executes a command, or the current prompt when omitted.

methods.name: toggleSource(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Shows or hides the editable source.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-javascript>` element provides an interactive JavaScript interpreter.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Action | Result |
| --- | --- |
| :tp-icon:{name="code" size="2em"} Edit source | Show or hide the source editor. |
| :tp-icon:{name="javascript-tracer" library="components" size="2em"} Trace execution | When enabled, record the current source and query in a drawer initially occupying 75% of the window, without changing the interpreter session. |
| :tp-icon:{name="play" size="2em"} Run | Reload changed source, then execute the query and display its result. Keep the session when the source is unchanged. |
| :tp-icon:{name="delete-outline" size="2em"} Clear | Clear the transcript while retaining session variables. |
| :tp-icon:{name="refresh" size="2em"} Reset | Restore the original program and initial command. |
| :tp-icon:{name="palette" size="2em"} Color | Choose this interpreter's brand color. |
| :tp-icon:{name="theme-light-dark" size="2em"} Theme | Change this interpreter's theme. |
| :tp-icon:{name="fullscreen" size="2em"} Fullscreen | Enter or leave fullscreen. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>ArrowUp</kbd> / <kbd>ArrowDown</kbd> | Recall previous commands or restore the current draft. |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between controls. |
| <kbd>Return</kbd> or <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Return</kbd> in the query field | Reload the program if its source changed, then run the current query. Keep the session if unchanged; retain the query text. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open contextual help for the component under the pointer, falling back to the focused component; Shift may be needed to type ?. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open the component viewer. |
